name: Allulose Honey Dipper
skillFull: A honey dipper appears at certain intervals, slowly spinning and drawing in nearby Jellies. As more Jellies stick to it, the clump at the end of the dipper grows larger. After a fixed amount of time, the completed Honey Clump Jelly is launched forward. Level Up for more points for Honey Clump Jellies.
